pieces.name: Moth wing cape
pieces.styleNotes: A sage green and cream semi-circle or batwing-shaped cape in flowing chiffon or soft cotton, with painted or appliqued eye spots and long tapered tails like a luna moth. Wide wingspan so it flares when arms are raised.
queries: handmade luna moth wing cape sage green cream chiffon Etsy
moth wings cape adult sage green cream eye spots handmade
fairy butterfly wing cape green chiffon festival handmade

matches.reason: Luna moth wing cape in a lightweight, silky synthetic chiffon with a wing silhouette modeled on a real moth. This is the shorter small version meant to be worn over dresses and corsets, so the tails may be shorter than the style notes call for.
Cecropia moth wing cape in soft, silky synthetic chiffon in the shorter small version. The cecropia species pattern differs from the sage and cream luna moth look, so the color match needs checking.
Emperor moth wing cape in light silky synthetic chiffon, the shorter small version. The emperor moth design departs from the sage and cream luna moth palette, and the listing says colors may vary.

pieces.name: Dark fitted unitard
pieces.styleNotes: A simple, close-fitting long-sleeve unitard or jumpsuit in black or deep charcoal, matte stretch cotton or jersey. It acts as a quiet base so the pale wings stand out.
queries: black long sleeve unitard cotton spandex dancewear small brand
vintage black stretch jumpsuit fitted long sleeve secondhand
charcoal fitted bodysuit jumpsuit matte jersey handmade

matches.reason: Black long-sleeve fitted unitard in heavyweight cotton spandex with a garment-dyed, enzyme-washed finish, a scoop neck and full range of sizes XS-XL.
Charcoal long-sleeve fitted catsuit with full-length legs in velvet, though the shine departs from the matte jersey base and only XS and L are available.
Black full-length scoop-neck unitard in recycled tricot, but it has no sleeves listed, is final sale, and is only offered in size 5X.

pieces.name: Soft ivory faux fur collar
pieces.styleNotes: A fluffy ivory or cream faux fur collar or shrug, meant to mimic the furry thorax of a moth. Soft, plush and slightly shaggy, with a hook-and-eye or tie closure.
queries: handmade ivory faux fur collar neck wrap cream Etsy
vintage cream faux fur collar stole detachable
white fluffy faux fur shrug collar handmade costume

matches.reason: Handmade in Sweden from acrylic faux fur with a cotton lining and polyester ribbon, in a beige and ivory colorway that gives a soft cream ruff for the moth thorax.
Ivory faux fur collar about 24 inches long and 6 inches wide that layers over sweaters or jackets, giving a plush, shaggy thorax-style ruff; the description does not state a closure type.
Soft faux fur neck wrap in warm ivory tones with satin ribbon ties, which matches the tie closure in the brief and can drape over the shoulders; listed under the color name Sand.

pieces.name: Insect antenna headband
pieces.styleNotes: Feathery plumed moth antennae on a slim headband, in cream, ivory or pale sage. Feather or wire construction with a delicate, curved shape.
queries: handmade feather moth antennae headband cream ivory Etsy
luna moth antenna headband sage green feather handmade
feathered insect antennae headband fairy costume small shop

matches.reason: Black marabou feather antennae with silver lurex add a soft insect shape; this ready-made headband is darker than the pale moth palette.
A mass-market Forum Novelties butterfly antenna headband sold as a basic bug costume finishing touch, with no feathered plume or pale color stated in the listing.
A generic bopper-style antenna headband for ladybug, bee or ant looks, sized for ages 12 and up, with no feathered plume or cream and sage coloring described.

pieces.name: Dark ankle boots
pieces.styleNotes: Black or dark brown leather ankle boots with a low block heel or flat sole, slightly worn in. Vintage or witchy styling like lace-up or Chelsea boots keeps the base look grounded.
queries: vintage black leather ankle boots lace up women's
secondhand black Chelsea ankle boots leather vintage
handmade black leather lace-up ankle boots small brand

matches.reason: Black ankle boot with a genuine leather upper, western toe stitching and a pull-on shaft with vertical seam detailing, set on a chunky ribbed Mondo creeper sole with a bone motif and skull logo.

All-black lace-up brogue ankle boot with wingtip perforations, 8 eyelets and silver D-ring hardware, though the 2.5" platform sole is chunkier than a low block heel and the upper is polishable synthetic TUKskin faux leather.
Knee-high pointed creeper boot with a sheer floral lace shaft, corset back lacing and side zip on a synthetic TUKskin toe, so it is a dramatic punk piece rather than a grounded dark ankle boot.
